name: [🃏 Remnant Route 1] Ghost Simulator
desc:
Welcome to Ghost Simulator! Ghosts have taken over the world, and it's up to you to stop them!

👻 Capture ghosts
🎒 Upgrade your equipment
🐾 Unlock Pets to help you along your journey
👽 Defeat Bosses who threaten the safety of the world
💨 Unlock Hoverboards
🌎 Explore the biomes
💎 Complete lore-rich quests to unveil the story, earn rewards, and receive power-ups
♻️ Rebirth for powerful perks

Premium Users get 25% more Gems, Walkspeed, and Vacuum Range!

Join the BloxByte Games group for 10% bonus luck when opening crates in-game!
